xBRIEFInfo.author: overdeck/0.0.0
xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4334: External skill packs: pinned git sources mounted per launch, with pack on/off at global, project, and issue level

plan.title: External skill packs: pinned git sources mounted per launch, with pack on/off at global, project, and issue level
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

metadata.sizeJustification: 25 files in 6 subsystems: exactly the finalize limit. The pack mechanism (sources, adapters, mount, resolution, launch, CLI, API, UI, docs) is one vertical feature; the PRD's documented split (API+UI to a sibling issue) is not needed because the surface fits.

narratives.Problem: PAN-3942 lets operators turn skills on and off at global, project and issue level, but only for skills already on disk. Third-party skill collections (first mattpocock/skills) can only arrive by vendoring into sync-sources (unattributed, stale copies) or by user-scope plugin installs that leak into every session. Copying pack skills into ~/.claude/skills or ~/.agents/skills would collide by directory name and leak project-scoped packs into unmanaged sessions.
narratives.Proposal: A pack is a git repo pinned to an operator-approved commit, registered in config.yaml skills.packs and cached under ~/.overdeck/packs. Adapters (plain, claude-plugin, KNOWN_PACKS) derive the skill list and non-skill capabilities, which are reported as Not applied and never mounted. Pack skills (id pack/skill) are off by default and resolve with pack toggles and per-skill overrides at the three PAN-3942 levels. The existing pan skills launch-settings step builds a content-addressed mount and exposes it per launch through each harness plugin system: Claude Code via a per-launch --plugin-dir symlink, Codex via a local marketplace block plus a plugin cache copy in the per-agent CODEX_HOME. Both show skills as pack:skill so they never collide with bundled names. CLI verbs, API fields and a Skill packs UI section complete the feature. See PRD Part II (sections 11-15).
narratives.NonGoals:
- npm pack sources
- repo-declared packs (a committed file that enables or trusts a pack)
- adding packs from the dashboard (CLI-only in v1)
- capability grants: hooks, MCP servers, commands, env are never mounted or applied
- the Deft adapter (#3943)
- SageOx as a pack (#2444); it is refused as an integration
- retiring or editing the vendored Matt Pocock skill copies in sync-sources
- harnesses other than Claude Code and Codex
- remote (Fly) launches
- rewriting a live session's skills (changes apply at next launch)
- any edit to src/lib/launcher-generator.ts
- network or git calls inside the launch step
- user-scope Claude plugin installs or writes to ~/.claude/plugins

autoDecisions.summary: Pack skills are returned in listSkillStates().packs, not merged into listSkillCatalog()/skills (PD-1).
autoDecisions.rationale: The existing panel's inherited() treats absent global as on, which is wrong for default-off pack skills; a separate list keeps PAN-3942 behavior untouched.

autoDecisions.summary: Launch key = managedStateKey ?? overdeckEnv.agentId ?? sessionId computed in launcher-lines.ts; no key means no packs for that launch (PD-2).
autoDecisions.rationale: Keeps launcher-generator.ts (999 lines, ratchet) unchanged and keeps generated scripts deterministic for snapshots.

autoDecisions.summary: updateAvailable (git ls-remote) runs only on GET ?checkUpdates=1, fetched separately by the UI at global level (PD-3).
autoDecisions.rationale: The GET body is also the PUT response; network there would slow every toggle. No new route is needed.

autoDecisions.summary: The launch step runs no git; an uncached trusted commit skips the pack with a warning (PD-4).
autoDecisions.rationale: Rebuilding from a blobless repo can lazy-fetch blobs (network); launches must be offline and fail open.

autoDecisions.summary: Codex primary route (local marketplace block + hand-populated plugins/cache copy) is used; the $CODEX_HOME/skills fallback stays a documented contingency only.
autoDecisions.rationale: A planning probe on codex-cli 0.158.0 listed probepack:zebra-probe from a hand-populated cache and showed the cache copy is required (PRD §11).

autoDecisions.summary: Symlinks inside pack repos are never copied into mounts (PD-8).
autoDecisions.rationale: A pack symlink could point at host files; skills do not need symlinks and Codex drops them anyway.

autoDecisions.summary: pan skills set takes <args...> with --pack <id> (PD-9); list --json keeps the native array.
autoDecisions.rationale: Matches the issue's AC-5 command lines without breaking existing JSON consumers.

autoDecisions.summary: The live checkpoint runs its host-mutating setup by hand and ends by turning the pack off globally and back to inherit for the issue; its verify_commands are read-only.
autoDecisions.rationale: pan skills pack add --yes and set --pack on write the operator real config.yaml and would enable the pack for every future launch on this machine.

autoDecisions.summary: sources.ts receives reserved ids (CORE_SKILLS) from the CLI instead of importing resolve.ts.
autoDecisions.rationale: madge counts import type edges; importing resolve.ts from sources.ts would close a catalog -> sources -> resolve -> catalog cycle and fail lint:circular.

autoDecisions.summary: Keep all pack store code in store.ts and all CLI code in skills.ts; no scripts/ edits.
autoDecisions.rationale: Holds the plan at 25 files and 6 subsystems (the finalize limit) without splitting the feature.

narrative.Action: Setup (mutates this host, run once by hand): pan skills pack add mattpocock https://github.com/mattpocock/skills --ref v1.2.3 --yes && pan skills set --pack mattpocock on.
